DirtyBufferTracker
Implementation: [src/engine/render/allocator/DirtyBufferTracker.ts](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/render/allocator/DirtyBufferTracker.ts).
Package entry points: `retiam`.

items: DirtyBufferTracker: Tracks and coalesces dirty memory ranges for continuous CPU-to-GPU buffer streaming. Instead of issuing separate `writeBuffer` commands for every granular geometry update, this tracker merges adjacent or closely spaced updates (gaps <= MARGIN_THRESHOLD) into unified contiguous uploads, eliminating costly WebGPU API command submission overhead. Zero-Allocation Architecture: Pre-allocates and reuses internal DirtyRange pools to guarantee zero garbage collection during high-frequency animations.

Tracks and coalesces dirty memory ranges for continuous CPU-to-GPU buffer streaming. Instead of issuing separate `writeBuffer` commands for every granular geometry update, this tracker merges adjacent or closely spaced updates (gaps <= MARGIN_THRESHOLD) into unified contiguous uploads, eliminating costly WebGPU API command submission overhead. Zero-Allocation Architecture: Pre-allocates and reuses internal DirtyRange pools to guarantee zero garbage collection during high-frequency animations.

items: GlobalStateAllocator: High-performance global state allocator for all entity transforms, paint styles, and materials. Manages a single, massive GPU Storage Buffer (`array<EntityState>`) with a continuous CPU mirror. All entity states are fixed-size slabs (256 bytes = 64 Float32 elements), guaranteeing: - Zero memory fragmentation. - O(1) allocation and recycling. - Single GPUBindGroup bound once per render pass. - Coalesced partial streaming via DirtyBufferTracker.
